camera.reference: e-con See3CAM_24CUG with standard supplied lens (nominal FOV approximation)
camera.clip_note: Engineering rendering settings, not dataset hardware specifications
camera.intrinsics_source: Nominal supplied-lens H/V FOV converted to an ideal pinhole approximation; NOT measured device calibration. Rendering K/P and CameraInfo use the same values.
camera.hardware_mode: 1920x1200 UYVY over USB 3, 55 FPS reference; Gazebo publishes converted RGB without UYVY transport simulation
camera.shutter: global; Gazebo uses an instantaneous frame, without real exposure/blur simulation
fidelity_limits: No serial-specific real camera intrinsics or distortion calibration
Nominal 104.6x61.6 degree envelope is an approximation; fx/fy are independently derived to match it
No physical lens response, exposure or image-noise calibration
camera.simulation_rate_note: Simulation source publishes 15 Hz to reduce load; hardware reference can provide 55 FPS at this resolution.

lidar.reference: RoboSense EM4-T coverage approximation with reduced simulation sampling density
lidar.sampling_note: Low-density simulation profile: 600 x 260 uniform directions, 156000 rays/frame at 10 Hz (75 percent fewer directions than 1200 x 520). Original angular endpoints retained: horizontal [-60,59.9] degrees, vertical [-12.5,12.5] degrees. Spacing H=0.20016694 degree and V=0.09652510 degree. A reduced-load coverage approximation, not nominal EM4-T 520-line sampling or its central ROI mode.
lidar.range_note: 1 m nominal blind range; 120 m simulation cap for this project, not EM4-T maximum hardware range. Gaussian range noise sigma=0.05 m is a simplified engineering model, not calibrated reflectance-dependent error.
fidelity_limits: No central 40-degree high-resolution ROI scan mode
No rotating-mirror per-point firing time or scan motion distortion
No realistic glass/multipath or rain/fog model

synchronization.note: 15 Hz RGB and 10 Hz LiDAR are independently sampled; select nearest pairs and drop stale frames. Sensor update rate is simulation time, not guaranteed wall-clock throughput.

detection_region.note: Near field may narrow with sensor FOV. At 0.4 m height, horizontal EM4-T sees central flat ground from about 1.80 m relative to this reference. Unobserved area is not free space.
